rollback_strategies.dual_read_rollback: toggle SERVER_AWARE_READS_ENABLED=false; legacy user_id-only reads resume; no data change
rollback_strategies.server_aware_flag_rollback: unset SERVER_AWARE_READS_ENABLED and SERVER_AWARE_WRITES_ENABLED; restart backend
rollback_strategies.server_profile_rollback: drop server_profiles collection (only if no live use); restore users.level fields from snapshot
rollback_strategies.paid_wallet_rollback: drop accounts_wallet_paid and ledger; restore users.paid_gems_balance + purchase_history from snapshot
rollback_strategies.free_wallet_rollback: drop server_wallets_free; restore users.gold + users.gems_free from snapshot
